parallels.note: Sing to Yahweh! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!

translations.web: Sing to Yahweh, all the earth! Display his salvation from day to day.
translations.bsb: Sing to the LORD, all the earth. Proclaim His salvation day after day.
translations.kjv: Sing unto the LORD, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.
translations.asv: Sing unto Jehovah, all the earth; Show forth his salvation from day to day.
